# Length

Gives the size of a string, an array or an object.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Length(source)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | any | The value to measure. A boolean, a number or a function is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Number. For a string, its length in UTF-16 code units; for an array, its number of elements; for an object, its number of properties; for null, 0. A whole number, exact. Never null.

## Example

`Length("abc")` returns 3.

`Length([1, 2])` returns 2.

`Length(null)` returns 0.
